# Level Up Makers

> A parent-run path for ages 9–14. Students make a first game, then move into real code and the Godot engine. A grown-up runs any AI help.

Level Up Makers publishes one manual: Level Up: Make Your First Game with AI. It is a three-module path. Level Up 1 uses Microsoft MakeCode Arcade. Level 1 is free to read and print. The full manual is $15 on early-bird pre-order (regular $19) at https://payhip.com/b/6KDfn. You get Level 1 instantly. The full manual is delivered by Monday, November 16, 2026. The parent-and-student bundle is $29 and is not on sale yet (Coming Nov 16). Level Up 2, Real Code Quest, and Level Up 3, Bring Your World to Life, are coming soon, with no price listed yet.

Students invent original characters, then move from blocks to typed code and the Godot engine. Any AI help is typed by a grown-up on the grown-up's own account. These pages have no forms, analytics, or trackers, and they do not collect children's personal information.

- [Home](https://levelupmakers.com/): The learning path, the Level Up 1 outline, what students make, the safety rules, and planned prices for the first manual. Written for parents.
- [Level 1: Spark](https://levelupmakers.com/level-1/): Free chapter. Idea Forge, an original hero, and a tiny collect-it game in MakeCode Arcade, plus prompts a grown-up can paste into their own AI chat.

## Policies

- [Terms of service](https://levelupmakers.com/terms/): Rules for using the site. Level 1 is free. The full manual is an early-bird pre-order through Payhip.

- [Refund policy](https://levelupmakers.com/refunds/): How to ask about a manual pre-order. Earlier Loot Drop orders still have a way to ask.
